title: Lock-Free Queue Pattern
description: Runnable lock-free queue implementations: SPSC ring buffer in Python and JavaScript (Atomics + SharedArrayBuffer), batched variant, Java ConcurrentLinkedQueue demo, Rust MPMC via crossbeam ArrayQueue, and a throughput benchmark.
description_es: Implementaciones ejecutables de colas lock-free: ring buffer SPSC en Python y JavaScript (Atomics + SharedArrayBuffer), variante por lotes, demo de ConcurrentLinkedQueue en Java, MPMC en Rust con ArrayQueue de crossbeam y un benchmark de rendimiento.
